applicability: The Intent Reviewer surface (ReviewSurface) when the reader selects a family, an invariant or the whole task after the task context has at least one admitted review payload.
conditions: A frame (the task context's last admitted payload for the same repo, master, leaf and record) exists.
The selected subject's review has not answered yet; only then is the reading area replaced by the pending statement keyed to the requested question.
exclusions: The reviewer's first read, which has no frame and is stated at the surface level.
A different leaf or record, whose frame is never reused.
Server-side read latency of a first visit to a subject.
statement: Selecting a family, an invariant or the whole task keeps the review workspace, its navigation, family tree, source explorer and open disclosures mounted as the same DOM; while the selected subject is being read only the reading area changes, to a pending state bound to the requested question's key and labelled with the requested subject, and navigation stays usable.
